_description: POST /api/agents/{agentName}/invoke — Sends a message to an agent using the Azure AI Foundry Responses API and returns the assistant's reply. Replace {agentName} in the URL with your agent name (e.g., customer-support-agent).
message: Hi! My order #12345 hasn't arrived yet. It was supposed to be delivered three days ago. Can you help?
_notes: Set 'previousResponseId' to the 'responseId' from the previous response to continue the same conversation.
Omit 'previousResponseId' (or set to null) to start a fresh conversation.
Required query param '?projectEndpoint=<url>' specifies the Azure AI Foundry project to target.
Optional query param '?conversationId=<id>' links the conversation to a Foundry conversation record.
The returned 'responseId' should be saved and passed as 'previousResponseId' in follow-up calls.

_example_response.assistantMessage: Hello! I'm sorry to hear your order hasn't arrived yet. Let me look into order #12345 for you right away. Could you please confirm the email address used when placing the order so I can pull up the details?
